description: On a full Peano model with its given zero and successor, any two binary operations satisfying the addition and multiplication recursion equations coincide with the model’s addition and multiplication.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.recursive_operations_unique.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.FullModels M
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.peanoTheory)
  (a p : M → M → M) (a0 : ∀ (x : M), a x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) = x)
  (as :
    ∀ (x y : M),
      a x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M y) =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M (a x y))
  (p0 :
    ∀ (x : M),
      p x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
  (ps : ∀ (x y : M), p x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M y) = a (p x y) x) :
  a = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M ∧
    p = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M
